partI_summary.missionStatement: The Kansas City Woodworkers Guild promotes the art and craft of woodworking through education, community engagement, and shared access to tools and facilities. The Guild supports members at all skill levels through classes, special interest groups, and collaborative projects.

partIII_programServiceAccomplishments.missionStatement: The Kansas City Woodworkers Guild promotes the art and craft of woodworking through education, community engagement, and shared access to tools and facilities. The Guild supports members at all skill levels through classes, special interest groups, and collaborative projects.

programServices.description: Membership services: The Guild provided membership benefits including access to woodworking facilities, equipment, educational classes (Basic Woodworking, Intermediate Woodworking, Bandsaw Box, Intro to Hand Tool Woodworking), special interest group meetings (Laser Engraver SIG, Finishing SIG, Carving SIG, Hand Tool SIG, CNC SIG), monthly membership meetings, and community events such as the National Craft Open Studios Weekend. One confirmed membership application payment of $250.00 was received during the 2025 tax year. No program service expenses were recorded in QuickBooks for the 2025 tax year.

Educational classes and workshops: The Guild offered woodworking instruction including basic and intermediate woodworking courses, bandsaw box construction, and hand tool woodworking. No confirmed revenue or expenses attributable to educational programs were recorded in the 2025 tax year; all confirmed event registration payments are dated 2026.

Community outreach and special interest groups: The Guild hosted special interest group (SIG) meetings covering laser engraving, finishing, carving, hand tools, and CNC woodworking, as well as participation in the National Craft Open Studios Weekend. No revenue or expenses for these activities were confirmed in the 2025 tax year based on available QuickBooks and WildApricot data.

line4d_otherProgramServices.description: No other program services with confirmed 2025 revenue or expenses identified in source data.

scheduleO.narrative: The Kansas City Woodworkers Guild Inc. promotes the art and craft of woodworking through education, community engagement, and shared access to tools and facilities. The Guild supports members at all skill levels through classes, special interest groups, monthly membership meetings, and collaborative community projects such as the National Craft Open Studios Weekend. Programs include basic and intermediate woodworking courses, bandsaw box construction, hand tool woodworking, and special interest groups covering laser engraving, finishing, carving, hand tools, and CNC woodworking.

The organization does not currently have a formal documented process for governing body review of Form 990 prior to filing. The Treasurer reviews financial information and coordinates preparation of the return. The organization should consider adopting a formal policy requiring governing body review of the Form 990 before filing.

The organization makes its governing documents and financial statements available to the public upon written request directed to the Treasurer at 1717 Washington St, Kansas City, MO 64108-1121. The organization does not currently post these documents on a publicly accessible website.
